content: Toledo Children's Hospital is a public healthcare facility dedicated to pediatric care, situated in Toledo, Ohio. The hospital operates within the larger framework of The Toledo Hospital and is administratively integrated into the ProMedica Health System. It is designated as a Level I trauma center, indicating its capability to provide comprehensive care for critically injured pediatric patients. The hospital is equipped with a total of 151 beds, 78 of which are specifically allocated for intensive care services. In the year 2006, Toledo Children's Hospital provided medical care to 4,856 pediatric patients. During the same year, the hospital managed 26,469 emergency cases, reflecting its significant role in addressing urgent and acute medical needs. Additionally, nearly 2,000 surgical procedures were performed at the facility, underscoring its capacity to deliver advanced surgical interventions for children.
